We need new combination not tested. Options: A trimmed_mean pool_full trim 0.2. B best_single pool1 ONLY_CWT_rf already tested. C dba pool2. D best_single pool2 ONLY_CWT_rf already. E best_single pool3 THETA. F median pool4. G best_single pool4 THETA. H mean pool5.

Pick one: maybe median pool4 (F) to see robust.

Test a robust median combination over pool1 to see if it improves on the mean baseline.

decision.justification: Selected 'mean on pool1' (a seeded deterministic baseline) as the best of 22 backtested attempts, score -0.0703. Series context: trend strength 0.9926 and seasonal strength 0.6275; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.228); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 1.444.
